messages:
michael: Quick EOD standup — what I did: pushed k8s fix to dedicated routing; blockers: waiting on privacy docs from legal; today: sync with SE + prod demo tomorrow. @tanya @alex any updates on HSM/KMS for Nova deal? :eyes:
tanya: Pushed updated SOW + KMS answers to the drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/xyz — legal asked for a key rotation policy sample. Attached a one-pager. pinging @jessica for legal review.
jessica: Saw it, will review tomorrow AM. Quick note: customer asks for HSM attestation — do we have the template? @harry
harry: SE here — I have the attestation template, can convert to Nova branding. Sending via DM. For on-prem/private, we need to confirm network egress policy; they'll need a couple IPs to whitelist.
alex: FYI pipeline update — Nova execs want dedicated capacity numbers (qps & p50). I sent a sample perf deck. Also asked about data residency (EU). @olivia can you confirm region options?
olivia: We can do EU Dedicated + Private in FRA. I'll confirm with infra about capacity lead time. ETA ~2 business days.
tanya: Blocker — customer wants KMS integration with their Azure subscription; we support Azure Key Vault via wrapped keys but need team to confirm SAML/SCIM mapping for service accounts. @michael can you coordinate?
michael: I'll loop in infra next thing. Also for demo tomorrow — can someone drop a quick runbook? simple steps to toggle fallback model if Dedicated capacity hits limit. @harry / @alex
harry: Adding runbook snippet:
```
# fallback flow
1. route policy: primary -> dedicated-arn
2. fallback: hosted-gpt-small
3. test: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I'll post full doc in #eng-runtime later.
olivia: Noted. no blockers from infra side. :thumbsup:
jessica: Legal will get rotation policy + attestation by EOD Wed. If customer needs earlier, ask them to sign NDA addendum.
michael: Solid, thanks everyone. If anything urgent DM me. Closing this thread.
